D.treatment: states committing to targeted intensive tutoring

O.outcome_detail: number of states reporting tutoring-related commitments

result.effect: at least 17 states; at least 5; at least 6

cells.quote: In the plans submitted to the US Department of Education, at least 17 states have committed to investing in targeted intensive tutoring, at least five have committed to building statewide tutoring programs, and at least six have committed to providing state-level guidance and support targeted intensive tutoring programs.
cells.note: This is a descriptive policy count, not an outcome comparison or estimate of tutoring effectiveness; the comparison category is inferred because the study does not report outcomes for states without a stated commitment.

cells.quote: Indeed, among the best prepared students in the country, those from low-income families enter selective colleges at half the rate of similarly prepared students from high-income families.
cells.note: The study text does not specify the participants' exact ages, setting, duration, or research design.
